title: Biofield Tuning Sessions & Tuning Fork Sound Healing Explained | Extended Episode
description:
What is your aura, and can a tuning fork actually read it? In this solo episode, Chance Garton explains how tuning forks find and release stuck energy in the electromagnetic field around the body, drawing on more than 600 tuning sessions of his own and the work of Biofield Tuning founder Eileen Day McKusick, author of Tuning the Human Biofield and Electric Body, Electric Health.

In this extended episode for members, Chance adds a full hour walking through the biofield anatomy on his interactive 3D map, from the Earth Star and the feet up through the root, sacral, solar plexus, heart, throat, third eye and crown, with stories from real sessions along the way.
